data.narrative: Module 10 chose a single container so rollback is one image SHA. Dockerfile binds 0.0.0.0 and PORT; CI runs on PRs including the module 09 suite. BREAK pointed HEALTHCHECK at /ready (503 while /live was 200), which would kill the whole process. FIX restored /live for liveness; /ready stayed 503 with database disconnected. Docker and Railway were not run.

dimension_scores.observation: Chose single_container so one SHA rolls back API plus in-process worker; rejected multi-service because Docker/Redis/Postgres are not up.
dimension_scores.evidence: DECIDE A. docker info exit 1. LIVE 200 READY 503. No Railway token.

dimension_scores.observation: Used the VERIFY 503 as the inject target: healthcheck on /ready made PLATFORM_WOULD_KILL true; FIX made probe 200.
dimension_scores.evidence: BREAK PROBE_STATUS 503 PLATFORM_WOULD_KILL True. FIX PROBE 200 PLATFORM_WOULD_KILL False. READY still 503.

dimension_scores.observation: Env list keeps secrets out of git; did not print DATABASE_URL. Not a new auth change this module.
dimension_scores.evidence: api/.env.example has empty secrets. emit_log redacts database_url.

dimension_scores.observation: Split liveness and readiness; migrations are one-off; HTTP/DB timeouts set; rollback is previous SHA not alembic downgrade.
dimension_scores.evidence: railway healthcheckPath /live after FIX. migrate.sh not in CMD. timeout-keep-alive 5 graceful 30. DB_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_S 1.

dimension_scores.observation: Named ASGI as curl stand-in and docker info exit 1 instead of a fake container run.
dimension_scores.evidence: CONTAINER_RUN not_run. RAILWAY_OR_COMPOSE_NOT_RUN True. CI_DEPLOY_REQUIRES_READY_200 in yaml only.

strengths: Healthcheck vs readiness split proven with LIVE 200 and READY 503, not a story.
Single-container rollback unit kept explicit: killing /ready liveness restarts API and worker together.
growth_areas: No container run or Railway deploy; docker info exit 1. CI deploy job still unexecuted.
data.recommendation: When Docker works, run the image, curl /live 200 and /ready (expect 503 until Postgres), then SIGTERM and confirm on_shutdown logs before claiming a platform rollout.

public_evidence.artifact: Single-container Dockerfile, Railway healthcheck, PR CI
public_evidence.student_action: Bound 0.0.0.0 and PORT, split /live vs /ready, added shutdown dispose and PR tests, then fixed a /ready liveness misconfig.
public_evidence.technical_detail: api/Dockerfile HEALTHCHECK /live; railway.toml healthcheckPath /live; .github/workflows/ci.yml pull_request + module09_test_suite.py.
public_evidence.proof: LIVE 200 READY 503. BREAK platform-would-kill True; FIX False. docker info exit 1.
public_evidence.ability: Ships a container contract that does not restart on a down database.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Prevents the 'healthy app restart loop' when the platform probes the wrong path.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: /live 200 with no DB; /ready 503 database disconnected; healthcheck must use /live.
One SHA; /ready as liveness would restart API and in-process worker together.

teaching_approaches.detail: Pointed HEALTHCHECK at /ready, showed 503 would kill the unit, restored /live.
